i have a piece of code as below, which reads multiple data files. it does so by first reading line by line, and then reading data rows.
import openpyxl
from openpyxl import load_workbook

#create a new workbook
wb = load_workbook('c:/users/a/documents/desktop/new document.xlsx')

#add a sheet
wb.add_sheet('new document')

workbook = wb.active
worksheet = workbook.active

#loop through a file, one line at a time.
for data in workbook.get_organized_data():
    print(data.row,data.address)
    # do stuff with the data

# loop another file, line by line
for data in workbook.get_organized_data2():
    print('address:'+ data.address)
    # do stuff with the data
